criteria.sameWorkload: Same 32 MiB resident Python fixture, SDK client, one session, ten echo calls and reverse callback.
criteria.cold: Elapsed client connect, tools/list and first echo; includes starting variant processes.
criteria.warm: Ten serial echo round trips, individual latency in milliseconds.
criteria.longCall: Three-second call must complete under two-second idle deadline.
criteria.idle: Resource sample after three seconds without client requests; retain proxy/supervisor cost.
criteria.wake: Attempt echo. Gateway may explicitly expire: record failure and one reconnect in its time. Stateless stdio must resume on the same client connection after metadata validation.
criteria.resources: Canonical Windows ownership selection validates every parent/child creation time against snapshot cutoff and previously observed root birth identities. Sum private bytes and working set; unavailable entries invalidate a complete resource claim.
criteria.cleanup: After closing owned transports/supervisor, no matching observed PID+creation identity remains alive.
criteria.guards: Abort variant if <3 GiB system RAM available or managed private bytes >768 MiB.

plan.decisionRule: Report raw observations and medians; no general winner or subscription/token saving inferred.
